name: Temporary refuge (TR) and safe haven
description: The space, usually in or near the accommodation, where personnel shelter from fire and blast while mustering. It needs a fire/blast rating, ventilation protection and independent communication.

gaps.what: TR fire/blast rating, occupancy and independence
gaps.why: No page read gives the TR rating or the independence requirement.
gaps.next_action: Fetch NORSOK S-001 or ISO 13702 and record TR rating, occupancy and independence

notes: Created 2026-11-27 in the offshore-platform component sweep (item from the platform structure taxonomy). No page read yet for this class, so the gap names the parameter and where to look; Wikipedia is cited only as secondary context.
